Bunsen Torch.name: Bunsen Torch
Bunsen Torch.description: Though heavily debated, the more militant factions in the Senate could push through that licensed captains are allowed to equip their boarding crews with these advanced flamethrowers to break the resistance of enemy crews. However, most people would consider this weapon to be inhumane.

Bunsen_Torch.name: Bunsen_Torch
Bunsen_Torch.description: Right when the war ended, the Bunsen Torch was banned not only in the territories of the Free Worlds, but by the peace agreement also everywhere else. As to be expected, the Pirates didn't care and recognized a business opportunity. 	However, torches bought legally during the war still won't be fined because of exception rules in the corresponding paragraphs.

Bunsen Burner.name: Bunsen Burner
Bunsen Burner.description: Being a more sophisticated version of the flamethrower, the Bunsen Burner represents the epitome of Free Worlds creative extravagance. The fuel requirements are so significant that it comes with a pre-installed fuel pod. Nevertheless its usage became feasible only with the introduction of the catalytic ramscoop.

Bunsen Burner Turret.name: Bunsen Burner Turret
Bunsen Burner Turret.description: Being a more sophisticated version of the flamethrower, the Bunsen Burner represents the epitome of Free Worlds creative extravagance. The fuel requirements are so significant that it comes with a pre-installed fuel pod. Nevertheless its usage became feasible only with the introduction of the catalytic ramscoop. 	One of the disadvantages of the flamethrower turned out to be that it's only effective when employed on ships which are big enough to be equipped with ramscoops and several fuel pods. As such ships are often slower in turning, the Bunsen Burner comes also in a turret version with high turning rate.
